```lean
intro x hx
let n := ⌊x⌋₊
have h1 : n ≤ x := floor_le
have h2 : n ≥ 1 := le_of_lt (lt_trans (lt_one_of_gt hx) (le_rfl))
have h3 : Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x ≥ 0 :=
  add_nonneg (div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_refl (Real.log 4)) (le_refl x))
              (le_refl (√x)))
let h4 : Real.log √x > 0 :=
  lt_trans (lt_zero_of_neg (Real.log_pos (sqrt_pos (le_refl x))))
           (le_refl (Real.log √x))
have h5 : Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x = Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x :=
  rfl
have h6 : ↑n.primeCounting ≤ Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x :=
  let h7 : n.primeCounting ≤ Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x :=
    let h8 : n.primeCounting ≤ Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x :=
      sorry
  h8
exact h6
```
